company.name: Known Medicine
company.shortDescription: Known Medicine combines patient-specific 3D cell culture and AI to translate drugs to clinical success
company.description: Known Medicine is looking to take the experimentation of how tumors respond to cancer drugs out of the patient’s body and into the lab. The startup breaks down tumor samples into micro tumors, which they treat separately inside specialized micro-environments with different methods and see what works best.
company.headquarters: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

productsAndServices.description: An assay that uses machine learning to analyze living patient cancer cells' responses to drugs, identifying predictive biomarkers and likely responders.
productsAndServices.name: Machine Learning-Based Sensitivity Assay

productsAndServices.description: A platform that builds a large dataset of patient cancer cells grown in 3D cultures, capturing their responses to hundreds of drugs and combinations through imaging.
productsAndServices.name: 3D Cell Culture Dataset Platform

aiResearchSummary.text: Known Medicine is engaged in the development of high-throughput three-dimensional cell-culture systems and methods. These systems are designed to ensure an even distribution of cells across well surfaces, enhancing imaging analysis. This aligns with their focus on using patient-specific 3D cell culture and AI to improve drug translation to clinical success, highlighting their commitment to advancing personalized medicine through innovative cell culture technologies.
